task: Make no-op schema-parity baseline regeneration deterministic and guard against volatile metadata regressions.

acceptance.check: Two consecutive no-op verify-schema-parity --update regenerations are byte-identical in an isolated temporary workspace.
acceptance.evidence: verify-schema-parity-determinism runs the real CLI twice with --root pointed at a disposable fixture and compares exact bytes.

acceptance.check: Regenerated top-level output contains no volatile generated_at field and retains sorted deterministic tables.
acceptance.evidence: The guard parses fixture output, rejects generated_at, and checks the exact sorted tables payload.

acceptance.check: Schema-parity verification still consumes the deterministic tables payload.
acceptance.evidence: The guard verifies the clean fixture, then removes a committed column and requires COLUMN_NOT_IN_BASELINE failure.

acceptance.check: A planted old writer using Date, toISOString, or generated_at fails.
acceptance.evidence: Guard --selftest requires one planted old writer containing all three volatile patterns to produce all three expected violations.

acceptance.check: The new guard is auto-discovered without editing package.json or CI workflows.

note: CI-only. This removes qualifying timestamp churn and timestamp-only baseline conflicts; it does not claim to prevent unrelated PR failures or all GitHub conflicts.
